reviews.title: Great value and product
reviews.comment: This power source is of a good quality by a reputable company.  I bought this for an AM4 Ryzen 7 5800x3d system with a RX 6700. It has more than enough power for my system and is relatively quiet.  Having just purchased it I cannot comment on durability, however based on past purchases of Cooler Master power sources I expect it will last quite a while.  It only took 2 days to have the product delivered after purchasing it.  I would buy from this seller again.
reviews.author: Ben

reviews.title: Power PC
reviews.comment: The Cooler Master power supply keeps your PC nice and cool, the size is accurate, provides power for your PC, looks good, and the weight is great.
reviews.author: Crimsonkai

reviews.title: More power to you.
reviews.comment: Built a set up for my wife and she loves it. It has a very steady flow, no spikes as in some cheaper power supplies. It was a little hard to fit in the case I built for her but I also have big hands. It has been running for over a year and still has had no issues (only user errors). The sale price was a great buy for the value.
